live_run_on_an_archive_copy.note: Only these six sources were run. The rest of the archive has no observation yet and shows no tag.

accuracy_sample.method: Opened random vacancies marked gone in a browser.
accuracy_sample.limit: A small sample. It shows that gone rows were really gone, not that no live job was ever marked gone.

filter_fix.problem: New labs were not in the company catalog, so OpenAI sat among 853 Other Tier companies and disappeared under Top Tier or a region filter.
filter_fix.fix: 27 labs added to company_catalog.AI_LABS, not to search-profile.json, which also builds the HH search query. DeepMind is split from the Google group.
filter_fix.alias_risk: Aliases match as substrings. None of the 926 current company names collide, but short names such as Pika or Figure could match a future employer.

limits: The daily-run changes have not run on GitHub.
A vacancy marked gone loses its last-seen date, because membership keeps one row per scope. The tag shows when absence was noticed.
last_seen now changes on all rows each day, which adds to the git history until data moves out of git in stage 7.
Tencent, ByteDance and DeepSeek are not tracked.
Sber and Yandex listings cover part of each site, so absence there is a weaker signal.
The check button was shown but not clicked in the browser. The source run it starts was tested separately.
